name: Parking Space Management and Revenue Statistics

map.按车场总车位、包月占用与临停数据，算出临停周转率、日均在场车辆数、车位占用率与月: From the total number of spaces, monthly occupancy and transient parking data, compute the transient turnover rate, average daily vehicles on site, space occupancy rate and monthly revenue mix, for the property monthly report and income disclosure. Average vehicles on site is estimated from "transient parking sessions × average parking duration ÷ 24". Data is processed locally in the browser only and never uploaded.

map.登记车位占用与收费记录，统计周转率与收入，按时段汇总，用于停车场运营核算，纯前端: Logs parking-space occupancy and charges, computes turnover and revenue, and summarizes by time period for parking operations accounting; records stay in the browser.
map.临停周转与占用（本页实算口径）：临停可用车位 = 总车位 − 包月车位；周转率: Short-term parking turnover and occupancy (as computed on this page): available short-term spaces = total spaces − monthly spaces; turnover = average daily short-term entries ÷ available short-term spaces (entries/space·day); average vehicles on site = average daily short-term entries × average duration ÷ 24 (vehicles); space occupancy = (monthly spaces + average on-site vehicles) ÷ total spaces × 100 (%), capped at 100% with a verification warning when above capacity. Validation: no field may be blank or negative; total spaces, monthly spaces, entries and days must be integers; total spaces must be > 0; average duration must be 0–24 hours. Rule: when available spaces are 0, turnover is shown as "Not applicable", not as 0.
map.停车收入测算（本页实算口径）：临停日均收入 = 日均临停车次 × 平均时长 ×: Parking revenue estimate (as computed on this page): average daily short-term revenue = average daily short-term entries × average duration × unit price (CNY); short-term revenue for the period = daily revenue × statistics days (default 30); rent revenue for the same period = monthly spaces × monthly rent × statistics days ÷ 30; total revenue for the period = short-term revenue + rent revenue; monthly output per space = period revenue ÷ statistics days × 30 ÷ total spaces. Assumptions: monthly spaces are occupied full-time; short-term parking is billed linearly; no free periods, caps or discounts; peak occupancy cannot be inferred from daily averages. Rule: no fixed grading; revenue varies linearly with entries, duration, unit price, days and monthly rent.
map.估算口径：包月车位按全时占用；临停收入按统计天数线性外推（默认 30 天）；不含: Estimation basis: monthly spaces are assumed occupied full-time; short-term revenue is extrapolated linearly over the statistics days (default 30); free periods, caps and discounts are excluded. Peak occupancy cannot be inferred from daily averages.
